en.title: K-Pop Breakout Rei Ami to Host ABC's New Music Competition Series
en.summary: Get ready for a fresh take on music competitions! Rei Ami, the voice behind Zoey in 'KPop Demon Hunters,' is stepping into the hosting spotlight for ABC's upcoming series, 'Who's In The Band?' Premiering summer 2027, the show promises a unique look into the creation of pop groups.
en.body:
The landscape of music competition shows is about to get a major shake-up. **Rei Ami**, the breakout star known for her role as the singing voice of Zoey in the hit series **‘KPop Demon Hunters’**, has officially been tapped to host the brand-new series **‘Who’s In The Band?’** This contemporary twist on the traditional talent show is slated to premiere in the summer of 2027, bringing its unique format to ABC, Disney+, and Hulu.

The show, a collaborative effort from **Richard Bacon’s Yes Yes Media** (backed by SISTER Group), **Syco Entertainment**, and **Savan Kotecha**, aims to pull back the curtain on what it truly takes to assemble a chart-topping pop group. Viewers will witness contestants facing a novel challenge: performing the same song simultaneously within isolated, soundproof tubes. The innovative format will allow judges to isolate individual vocals in real-time, offering an unprecedented glimpse into the meticulous process of vocal selection and group cohesion. This is not just about finding a singer; it's about finding the *right* voices that blend to create a hit.

## Assembling the Next Big Thing

**‘Who’s In The Band?’** is designed to offer an insider’s perspective on the often-mysterious world of pop music creation. From the initial vocal auditions to the final group dynamic, the series will track the journey of aspiring artists as they navigate the challenges of forming a cohesive and successful band. The production team, including executive producers like **Elisabeth Murdoch**, **Richard Bacon**, and **Simon Cowell**, is clearly aiming for a show that is as educational as it is entertaining. The series promises a fast-paced competition that captures the excitement and pressure of the modern music industry, culminating in a live finale where the final band will be revealed to the world. While the judging panel is still under wraps, **Rei Ami**'s position as host is confirmed, making her the central figure guiding us through this musical experiment.

## What Fans Can Expect

For fans of **‘KPop Demon Hunters’** and the broader world of music creation, **‘Who’s In The Band?’** represents a compelling new narrative. The show’s premise taps directly into the audience’s fascination with how their favorite groups are formed, offering a behind-the-scenes look that goes beyond typical reality TV. The real-time vocal isolation technology and the focus on building a group from the ground up suggest a level of depth that will resonate with dedicated music fans who appreciate the craft involved. The summer 2027 premiere date means there's time for anticipation to build, and the multi-platform release across ABC, Disney+, and Hulu indicates a significant push to capture a wide audience. This is more than just a singing contest; it’s a deep dive into the alchemy of pop stardom.

## What's Next

With a summer 2027 premiere on the horizon, the next crucial details to emerge will undoubtedly be the identities of the judging panel and the specific contestants who will be vying for a spot in the band. Keep an eye on official announcements for further casting news and a more precise release date.
